{"items":[{"content":{"body":"# Stage S1 — Control-plane validation

Validates the Gatebraid Classic control plane end to end on the scratch
repository: the Stage/Phase/Slice hierarchy, the two dependency encodings of
ADR-0007, and the Project field contract of spec §1–§3. This Stage delivers
evidence that the control plane behaves as specified before any business work
is admitted to it.

## Scope

- A four-Slice sample hierarchy carrying both dependency encodings.
- A read-only verification pass proving metadata and native edges agree with
  ADR-0007.

## Phases

<!-- Maintained as sub-issues; list here is informational and may lag. -->
- P1 — Sample hierarchy and dependency encoding (sub-issue)

Builds the four-Slice sample hierarchy in the scratch repository and encodes
the two ADR-0007 dependency forms across it: metadata-only edges for Gate 1
and Gate 2 predecessors, and metadata plus a native blocked-by edge for the
single Gate 3 predecessor. The Phase exists so the soft and hard encodings can
be observed diverging on the same graph.
